name: Sunforge Outlaw
premise: Kael moves through the Sunfields while people mistake him for men they need, fear, blame, or miss. Each mistaken identity pulls him into a human problem already in motion; his presence shifts how people behave, and the situation resolves sideways.
worldRules: No clean borders; people navigate by routes rather than maps.
Sunforges are buried or half-exposed structures that react to sunlight; people work around them without a shared explanation.
Settlements are temporary holds along movement routes.
Nothing important waits; convoys, riders and traders keep moving.
storyEngine: Kael arrives; something is already happening; his presence shifts how people behave; it resolves sideways.
